lines.english: Mina works in marketing.

lines.serbian: Njena kancelarija je na petom spratu.
lines.croatian: Njezin ured je na petom katu.
lines.english: Her office is on the fifth floor.

lines.serbian: Svako jutro pije kafu i čita mejlove.
lines.croatian: Svako jutro pije kavu i čita mailove.
lines.english: Every morning she drinks coffee and reads her emails.
Today she has an important task.

lines.serbian: Mali kafić u centru grada traži novu reklamu.
lines.croatian: Mali kafić u centru grada traži novu reklamu.
lines.english: A small café in the city centre wants a new ad.

lines.serbian: Mina piše tekst za plakat: „Prva kafa je besplatna!“
lines.croatian: Mina piše tekst za plakat: „Prva kava je besplatna!“
lines.english: Mina writes the text for a poster: "The first coffee is free!"

lines.serbian: Šalje plakat u štampariju i ide kući.
lines.croatian: Šalje plakat u tiskaru i ide kući.
lines.english: She sends the poster to the printer's and goes home.
The next morning, her boss calls her.
"Mina, have you seen the poster?"
Mina opens the picture on her phone.

lines.serbian: Na plakatu piše: „Svaka kafa je besplatna!“
lines.croatian: Na plakatu piše: „Svaka kava je besplatna!“
lines.english: The poster says: "Every coffee is free!"

lines.serbian: – O, ne! To je moja greška!
lines.croatian: – O, ne! To je moja greška!
lines.english: "Oh no! That's my mistake!"
Mina runs to the café.
There's a long queue outside the door.
Everyone wants free coffee.

lines.serbian: Vlasnik kafića stoji za šankom i gleda je.
lines.croatian: Vlasnik kafića stoji za šankom i gleda je.
lines.english: The café owner stands behind the counter and looks at her.
"I'm sorry," Mina says quietly.
The owner laughs.

lines.serbian: – Zašto? Ljudi piju kafu, ali kupuju i kolače!
lines.croatian: – Zašto? Ljudi piju kavu, ali kupuju i kolače!
lines.english: "Why? People drink the coffee, but they buy cakes too!"
"We've sold all the cakes today."
"We've never had so many customers."
In the afternoon, her boss calls again.

lines.serbian: – Bravo, Mina! Kafić želi još jednu reklamu.
lines.croatian: – Bravo, Mina! Kafić želi još jednu reklamu.
lines.english: "Well done, Mina! The café wants another ad."
Mina smiles.

lines.serbian: – Ovog puta – kaže – proveriću tekst dva puta.
lines.croatian: – Ovaj put – kaže – provjerit ću tekst dvaput.
lines.english: "This time," she says, "I'll check the text twice."
